(Representative Image: Wikimedia Commons) The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has announced the CBSE board exam dates 2027 for both Class 10 and 12 students. CBSE Class 10 exams 2026 phase 1 will be held from February 16 to March 9. The CBSE Class 12 exams 2027 will also start on February 16 and continue until April 9.

 IMP. Ques & PYQ's: Physics | Chemistry | Maths | Biology | English 
 Formula Sheet & PYQ's: Physics | Chemistry | Maths |  PYQ's (All Subjects) 
 Students can download the CBSE board exam date sheet 2027 PDF from the official website at cbse.gov.in. Students can download the CBSE subject-wise date sheet PDF 2027 and save it for future use until the conduct of the board exams. 
 CBSE board will held CBSE Class 10, 12 practicals 2027 for regular schools from January 1 to February 13, while winter-bound schools will conduct practical and internal assessments from November 9 to December 19, 2026.
 The LOC submission process for CBSE schools is complete. According to the board’s notice, the Class 10 board exams will cover 83 subjects, and the Class 12 exams will cover 121 subjects.

 CBSE Date Sheet 2027: How to download PDF?
 The steps to download the CBSE date sheet 2027 for Class 10 and 12 board exams are as follows. 
 Visit the official website at cbse.gov.in.
 Navigate to the ‘Main Website’ section.
 Click on CBSE Class 10 or 12 date sheet 2027 link available.
 CBSE timetable 2027 PDF will appear on the screen.
 Download the PDF and save it for future reference.
 More than 19.8 lakh Class 12 students and over 26.5 lakh Class 10 students have registered for the 2027 board examinations. The CBSE Class 10 and 12 board exam 2027 timetable will include other important details, such as subject-wise dates, timings, exam-day guidelines, and other instructions.
 To pass the CBSE Class 10 and 12 board exams 2027, students need to score a minimum of 33% in every subject. Those who fall short can appear for improvement or supplementary exams, depending on the CBSE rules for their class.

 CBSE Class 12 practical exam marks distribution 2027
 The CBSE Class 12 marks distribution varies across subjects. The details are given below.
 Physics, Chemistry and Biology: 70 marks theory and 30 marks practical.
 Mathematics: 80 marks for theory and 20 marks for internal assessment.
 Economics, Business Studies and Accountancy: 80 marks for theory and 20 marks for project work.
 Geography and Psychology: 70 marks for theory and 30 marks for practical.
 Computer Science: 70 marks for theory and 30 marks for practical.
 November 8, 2026 | 05:45 AM IST
 CBSE Class 10 Board Exam 2027: Practical marks distribution
 In most CBSE Class 10 subjects, the total marks are 100, divided into 80 marks for the theory examination and 20 marks for internal assessment. However, certain subjects follow a different marking scheme.
 Computer Applications: 50 marks for theory and 50 marks for practical.
 Painting: 30 marks theory, 50 marks practical and 20 marks internal assessment.
 Home Science: 70 marks for theory and 30 marks for practical.
 Elements of Business: 70 marks for theory and 30 marks for project work.
 Mathematics (Standard and Basic): 80 marks for theory and 20 marks internal assessment.
